tasks.short: Supply directions and local travel information

steps.what: Clarify guests' destinations, timing and requested travel information
Look up directions, services and points of interest in verified information cards
Supply guests with checked directions and resolve unmatched or unusual requests

tasks.design: Configure searchable verified information cards in {DOCS}. The bellhop clarifies each request and explains matched information; stale or unmatched requests receive manual checking.
tasks.enabler_now: Guest-information systems already support local-information answers, while fixed cards are sufficient for this narrower lookup.
tasks.still_hard: Changing opening hours and guest-specific travel needs.
tasks.human_edge: Practical explanation and help with unusual circumstances.

reach.learn: Which sources and directions remain reliable

evidence.claim: HiJiffy supports guest messaging and local information with staff handoff; this supports the narrower information-lookup opportunity, not a measured bellhop saving.
The fixed-card workflow and saving are unmeasured.

assumptions: Scope is information supply, without bookings or automatic price commitments.
In s1 the bellhop produces destination/service category, requested date/time and clarification notes; capture time is counted in 20%. No match goes to manual lookup in s3.

The bellhop maintains card title, address, directions, service hours, source and last-checked date in 8 incremental focal hours per 100 baseline; the concierge verifies difficult changes in 4 other-role hours. Stale cards are withheld until checked.
Use native document search before new code; existing automatic lookup earns no saving.
research_questions: How often can verified cards answer a request without new research?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=70, gross=30%; minus 8 focal content upkeep gives net 22%. Range 0-5% allows familiar answers needing no lookup and frequent manual exceptions; E1 scenario.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Explain and demonstrate room features and check guests understand their operation

tasks.design: Keep room-feature explanation and demonstration with the bellhop. {DOCS} can hold existing instructions, but the direct demonstration and guest check remain fully counted.
tasks.previous_blocker: Questions depend on the actual equipment and guest understanding.
tasks.enabler_now: No replacement of the physical demonstration is assumed.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing a misunderstanding from faulty equipment.

reach.learn: Which symptoms require maintenance rather than explanation

evidence.claim: Information lookup does not establish a reduction in hands-on room demonstrations.

assumptions: Only direct explanation and demonstration are counted.
The bellhop inspects actual equipment; no free room-model or fault flag is assumed.
Reuse current instructions without new software.
No changed process means no upkeep.
research_questions: Which room features most often need demonstration?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=net=0%; direct demonstration retains all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Act with the security team, observe conditions and respond within assigned responsibilities

tasks.design: Retain physical observation and security support with the bellhop and security team. Existing {TELEPHONY} supports contact without replacing vigilance or response.
tasks.previous_blocker: Security support depends on live conditions and appropriate judgement.

evidence.claim: Guest messaging does not replace physical security support.

assumptions: Scope is active security support, without invented incident paperwork.
Concerns arise through counted human observation; no automatic threat flags.
No changed workflow means no incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Which situations require immediate security-team contact?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross=net=0%. Physical security time remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Compute charge slips and maintain service records

steps.what: Capture services rendered, guest account and verified charge rates
Compute charge slips from checked quantities and rates and assemble service records
Check charge slip, resolve exceptions and accept exact account posting and record

tasks.design: Configure native calculation and linked service records in the existing {OTHER} hotel billing system. The bellhop captures actual services and checks the exact account and charge before posting.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual arithmetic and repeated slip transcription.
tasks.enabler_now: Native billing forms can calculate fixed quantities and rates.
tasks.still_hard: Confirming actual service, account ownership and unusual charges.
tasks.human_edge: The bellhop verifies the service rather than accepting a calculated amount blindly.

evidence.claim: Native billing calculation and linked records can remove repeated arithmetic and transcription; no local saving is measured.

assumptions: OTHER means the existing hotel billing system; test native configuration first.

In s1 the bellhop captures guest account, service code, date, quantity, unit, rate version and service evidence. They check finance-supplied rate and tax rules within the 35% capture step; missing rates stop for manual clarification.
Finance produces and maintains rate, currency, tax and rounding rules in 4 incremental other-role hours per 100 baseline; no free structured service-completed flag.
Only existing manual calculation/transcription earns savings; already automatic billing gives zero.
research_questions: How much charge-slip time is still manual after service capture?

already_counted.description: Service and rate capture and verification

approvals.approved_version: Exact guest account, service details, quantities, rate version, taxes and amount; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=60, gross=40%; minus 7 focal upkeep gives net 33%. Range 0-10% covers existing billing automation and service exceptions; unmeasured E1.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Guest service with simpler information and charge handling
reach: Coordinate information freshness with the concierge and charge rules with finance
role.ambitious_version: Reliable lookup and charge forms support attentive guest service without reducing physical assistance or security work.
